name: ZayZoon - Wages On-Demand
description:
Make today the new payday. How it works: Each day you work, you build up an available amount and can choose how much of your wages you’d like to receive, instantly! On your payday, you are paid normally, minus the amount you accessed early. 

ZayZoon allows you to access your earned but unpaid wages to avoid payday loans, late bill payments and overdraft fees. Its financial wellness tools provide overdraft prediction, financial tracking and financial education. 

What else there is to love:
Money transferred instantly, 24/7/365!
Flat fee to access money, no interest!
Trusted by your employer and payroll provider!
Financial tools and courses to improve your financial health!
Now get even more out of your ZayZoon payouts with Boost! Access 5-20% more of additional spending power when wages are redeemed on gift cards for essentials like groceries!

Note: to use this app, your employer must have an existing agreement with ZayZoon. Get your company onboard with ZayZoon by becoming an ambassador. See www.zayzoon.com/ambassador for more details.
